title: Nederland hoort de kunstmaan (Weeknummer 57-42) / The Netherlands hears the artificial moon
license: CC-BY-SA 3.0 NL (Open Beelden / Beeld en Geluid)
notes: Netherlands, Dutch: Polygoon-Profilti newsreel, 7 Oct 1957. The PTT radio station at Nederhorst den Berg picks up Sputnik's signal — a pulsed 780 Hz tone runs under the commentary — then ir. Wegener and radio-astronomer drs. De Feiter explain the sound at a press conference; animation of the satellite the USA is about to launch. Commentary Philip Bloemendal. Source MPG rendition from openbeelden.nl; first 17 s of the reel-can is another story and is not used.
